markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California rules in favor of Meta Platforms, Inc. on the plaintiff States' claims that it designed Facebook and Instagram to cause compulsive use by minors and that it misrepresented the safety of those platforms in the state attorney general actions in In re Social Media Adolescent Addiction/Personal Injury Products Liability Litigation, No. 4:22-md-03047 before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market turns on liability on two theories, not on money. It resolves YES only if the court rules for Meta on both the claim that it designed Facebook and Instagram to cause compulsive use by minors and the claim that it misrepresented the safety of those platforms. A ruling for the plaintiff States on either one resolves it to NO.

The ruling must be issued by the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California in these actions, must address the matter described by the specified judgment, and must be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment or decision. The advisory jury's verdict is not a ruling of the court, so only the court's own written findings of fact, conclusions of law, order or judgment count.

Outside this market:
The plaintiff States' claims under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), which are also being tried, and any claim or part of a claim resting on the COPPA violations the court found in June 2026, including an unfair competition claim predicated on them. A ruling for the States on any of those does not by itself resolve this market NO.
Monetary relief and its amount. The court may rule for Meta here and still order Meta to pay on the COPPA claims; what Meta is ordered to pay is measured by the separate market on that question.
Injunctive relief, however broad.
The personal injury, school district and other actions in this multidistrict litigation.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
A settlement of any size, or a voluntary dismissal, whether or not its terms are disclosed
A ruling for Meta on one of the two claims but not the other
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Administrative or scheduling orders, orders to show cause, and minute orders that do not address the substantive issue

For clarity: sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment, and per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings. Only the district court's ruling counts, and a later reversal on appeal does not reverse a settled outcome.
markets.title: Will the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California rule rules in favor of Meta Platforms, Inc. on the plaintiff States' claims that it designed Facebook and Instagram to cause compulsive use by minors and that it misrepresented the safety of those platforms?

markets.rules_primary: If CK Hutchison has achieved the superior outcome in the trial-level resolution of its Panama ports arbitration (originally filed in the ICC), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Panama ports arbitration is the International Chamber of Commerce arbitration brought against the Republic of Panama over the Balboa and Cristobal terminals by Panama Ports Company, CK Hutchison's subsidiary. A recovery by Panama Ports Company is a recovery by CK Hutchison for the purposes of this market. CK Hutchison's separate treaty-based claim against Panama, and its arbitration against Maersk, do not resolve this market. If no trial-level resolution occurs before the expiration date, the market resolves to No.

CK Hutchison achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): CK Hutchison achieves the superior outcome if they receive a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against CK Hutchison). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, CK Hutchison achieves the superior outcome if they prevail on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in their original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal, on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, CK Hutchison achieves the superior outcome if (as defendant) all claims are dismissed with prejudice, or (as plaintiff) opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: Superior outcome if net payment flows to CK Hutchison; no superior outcome if payment flows from CK Hutchison; no party achieves superior outcome if terms are sealed or undisclosed.

Key exclusions: Applies only to trial-level resolution and specifically excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes.
markets.title: Will CK Hutchison win its Panama ports arbitration?

markets.rules_primary: If the UK agrees to or announces a cut or repeal of its digital services tax before Apr 6, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.

A market resolves to Yes on a UK government announcement that abolishes the digital services tax, reduces its rate, raises either of its revenue thresholds, suspends it, or exempts companies from its scope. An announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal commitment by the head of government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Announcements with a specified future implementation date

Phased implementation announcements, and multi-party agreements to which the UK is a signatory, also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents or unofficial reports not confirmed by government sources
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval or adoption
Regional or sub-national actions
Retraction of previously announced commitments

2.80, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.rules_primary: If Rupert Lowe formally holds the position of Prime Minister of the United Kingdom before Jan 1, 2035, and is the first such subject to do so after Issuance, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The holder of the position at the time of Issuance is excluded. For the purposes of this Contract, only a subject who holds the position in a permanent, confirmed, elected, or otherwise non-acting and non-temporary capacity—as formally designated by the body or organization at which the position is held—is treated as formally holding the position; assumption of the role solely in an acting, interim, transitional, provisional, caretaker, pro tempore, or otherwise temporary capacity does not, by itself, satisfy the Payout Criterion.

Andy Burnham is the holder at Issuance.

A former holder who returns after Issuance is not disqualified solely on the basis of that prior service.

If a person not listed here is first to formally hold the office after Issuance, every market resolves NO.

markets.rules_primary:
If 
 Andy Burnham says Ukraine as part of next Prime Minister's Questions (UK House of Commons)
, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the next Prime Minister's Questions (UK House of Commons) using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the next Prime Minister's Questions (UK House of Commons) will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Andy Burnham speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.
For the purposes of this market, 'next Prime Minister's Questions (UK House of Commons)' refers to the next official PMQs session in which Andy Burnham participates, occurring after August 19, 2026 10:50 PM.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Additional content not included in the original broadcast or stream.
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.
